Great meeting today, thanks for the demo and the walkthrough of Redwood Dedicated/private options. Quick recap from ACME's side and a few clarifying Qs so we can lock the MAP:

- POC goal: Validate Redwood inference latency and deployment model for our internal search assistant (target SLA: 100ms tail for 1k qps).
- Target POC window: Jan 4–Jan 31, 2027 (customer side availability).
- Dependencies we need to resolve before kick-off: VPC peering and routes, IP allowlists on our firewall, SSO/SAML for SSO access to the console, secrets/KMS integration for service-to-service keys.

2) For SAML, what attributes do you require mapped (email, first/last, groups)?
3) KMS integration: do you require any particular key policy or can we use an existing key with cross-account access?

Procurement is copied on the timeline and will coordinate on the MSA. Please share a short MAP with milestones/responsibilities and any docs/network templates.

Thanks,
Taylor

Marissa — added technical details below (verbatim to paste into the network-reqs.xlsx).

1) VPC peering / networking
- Redwood will require an inbound peering connection from ACME VPC -> Redwood Dedicated VPC (Redwood will initiate accept).
- IP ranges (egress from Redwood to ACME): 54.201.10.0/24, 54.201.11.0/24. Please reserve these /24s on your firewall allowlist.
- Ports: TCP 443 outbound (for API/control plane), TCP 10250–10255 (if we need agent management) — default: only 443 needed for normal PoC.
- If ACME uses a transit gateway, ensure routes for 54.201.10.0/24 and 54.201.11.0/24 are propagated.

2) IP allowlist
- For Admin console access we also provide a CIDR: 34.120.200.0/26 (optional, for locked-down console access).

3) SSO / SAML
- Required attributes: NameID (email), email, givenName, sn, groups
- Assertion consumer URL / entity: https://console.redwood.ai/saml/acs
- Typical bindings: HTTP-POST
- We support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows; JIT provisioning supported for users with the groups attribute.

4) KMS / secrets
- For KMS we can either use a customer-managed key with a cross-account grant (preferred) or store wrapped secrets in Redwood-managed KMS.
- Minimum required IAM policy: Allow: kms:Decrypt, kms:Encrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/<key-id>. We'll provide a step-by-step policy snippet once ACME confirms account ID.

Attachments included: network-reqs.xlsx (tabbed matrix), redwood_map_draft_v2.pdf (MAP).

If ACME can confirm their AWS account ID and SAML metadata URL by 12/10 we can meet the 12/20 pre-PoC milestone.

— Nikhil
